title: Count the different owners
prompt: Write public static int UniqueOwners(List<string> owners). The list has one owner name per task, and an empty string means the task has no owner. Return how many different owners there are. Do not count the empty string.
hints: Which collection keeps each value only once?
Decide what to do with an empty string before adding a name.
Add every name that is not "" to a HashSet<string>, then return its Count.
checkLabels: Ana, Ben and Ana are 2 different owners.
The same owner twice counts once.
Tasks with no owner must not be counted.
A list of only unowned tasks has 0 owners.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Counts tasks instead of different owners.
Counts the empty string as an owner.

feedback: Check a list with a repeated name, then a list with an empty string in it. Repeats count once and the empty string is not an owner.
